The available source records describe measure HAPI-02, named “Hospital-acquired pressure injury rate,” with the unit reported as percent. For period 2026-Q1, the source record lists a numerator of 225, a denominator of 1274, exclusions of 32, and a rate of 18.12 percent. The event dates recorded for 2026-Q1 are 2026-01-19, 2026-05-17, 2026-05-19, 2026-06-27, and 2026-12-07.

For period 2026-Q2, the source record lists a numerator of 41, a denominator of 210, exclusions of 15, and a rate of 21.03 percent. The event dates recorded for 2026-Q2 are 2026-01-24, 2026-07-04, 2026-07-19, 2026-09-18, and 2026-11-09.

Taken together, the records provide period-level reporting for HAPI-02 using the same measure name and unit. The reported data elements are limited to the numerator, denominator, exclusions, rate, and event dates for each period. The 2026-Q1 record reports a larger denominator and numerator than the 2026-Q2 record, while the 2026-Q2 record reports a higher rate than the 2026-Q1 record. Exclusions are reported separately for each period, with 32 exclusions in 2026-Q1 and 15 exclusions in 2026-Q2.

This summary does not apply an external benchmark, target, or statistical test. It reflects only the structured values provided for HAPI-02 in the source records. No additional measure specifications, case definitions, validation notes, or stratified results were provided in the source records.
